scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare Account ID, shown in the R2 overview.

R2_BUCKET_NAME.description: Must exactly match the name of the BUCKET R2 binding, including any name you customize during setup.

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Create an R2 object read/write API token restricted to this bucket.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret Access Key for that bucket-scoped R2 API token. This stays on the Worker.

OWNER_TOKEN.description: Generate at least 32 random bytes, e.g. openssl rand -hex 32. Enter this connection token in MFinder.
